stories.title: 守护“深蓝”：“海巡22”船长的“在线”假期

en.title: Protecting the "Deep Blue": The Captain of "Hai Xun 22" Takes an "Online" Holiday
en.summary: During China's National Day holiday, large vessels and fishing boats continue operations at Ningbo Zhoushan Port. A ship captain remains on duty online during the holiday period to maintain port operations.

stories.title: 山东青岛：世界最长海底公路隧道盾构掘进全部完成

en.title: Shandong Qingdao: Shield Tunneling for World's Longest Submarine Highway Tunnel Completed
en.summary: Shield tunneling operations for the world's longest submarine highway tunnel have been completed in Qingdao's Jiaozhou Bay at 105 meters below sea level. The project was invested by Qingdao Guoxin Group and constructed by China Railway 14th Bureau.

en.title: Intelligent "High-Tech" on Display: Zhejiang Enterprises Tap into Central Asian Digital Market
en.summary: A digital technology exhibition organized by Zhejiang's commerce department took place in Astana, Kazakhstan from October 1-3, showcasing six leading Zhejiang digital technology enterprises. The event provided a platform for Zhejiang companies to access innovation resources and explore emerging markets in Central Asia.

stories.title: 宁波舟山港LNG加注覆盖金塘港区

en.title: Ningbo Zhoushan Port LNG Bunkering Expands to Jintang Harbor Area
en.summary: Ningbo Zhoushan Port, the world's largest container port, expanded LNG bunkering services to new areas as part of its green shipping transition efforts. LNG is increasingly being adopted as a clean energy choice for ocean-going vessels to reduce carbon emissions.

en.title: Food and Travel Program 'Seeking Flavors from Mountains and Seas' Explores Forest Delicacies in Dehua, Fujian
en.summary: A culinary and travel program aired on Chinese national television, taking viewers to Dehua in Fujian province to sample local mountain specialties including red mushrooms and local black chicken.

en.title: Shaanxi Normal University Library: Cultivating Character Through Collections and Continuing Cultural Heritage, Transmitting Knowledge to Forge Teacher Spirit
en.summary: Shaanxi Normal University Library uses its collections to preserve cultural continuity and transmit knowledge to develop the professional character and mission of education students.

en.title: National Library Open Course Resources National Promotion Activity Officially Launched
en.summary: The National Library of China launched a national promotion activity for its open course resources in Chengdu, showcasing over a decade of construction achievements with participation from libraries across the country.

en.title: Highway Connects Mountain Villages' Autumn Scenery, Promoting Year-Round Tourism in Taishun, Zhejiang
en.summary: During China's National Day holiday, Taishun in Zhejiang's Wenzhou attracted visitors who engaged in fruit picking and wine making, explored historic villages and ancient bridges, and enjoyed mountain scenery at scenic valleys.

en.title: Chinese Embassy in the UK Holds Reception for 'China-UK Study Tour Leadership Program'
en.summary: The Chinese Embassy in the UK hosted a reception for its China-UK Study Tour Leadership Program, attended by Chinese Ambassador Zheng Zeguang, British peers, and representatives from 14 UK universities to promote student exchanges between the two countries.

en.summary: Chinese boxer Han Xuezhen secured a silver medal in the men's 90 kilogram boxing competition at the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games.

stories.title: Developers vie to land plum HK$2 billion residential site in Ho Man Tin

en.title: Developers vie to land plum HK$2 billion residential site in Ho Man Tin
en.summary: Ten developers submitted bids for Hong Kong's sole residential site in the latest government land sale programme before Friday's deadline. Major firms including Chinachem Group, Wheelock Properties, Kerry Properties and Sun Hung Kai Properties competed for the Fat Kwong Street site in Ho Man Tin.

stories.title: Hong Kong IPOs falter, China aids homebuyers, EU trade talks

en.title: Hong Kong IPOs falter, China aids homebuyers, EU trade talks
en.summary: Hong Kong's initial public offerings are struggling as investor appetite weakens relative to supply. Seven of twelve September debuts fell on their first trading day, with fifteen flops recorded in the third quarter compared to fourteen declines in the first half of the year.

stories.title: China’s AI compute ambitions demand innovation

en.title: China's AI compute ambitions demand innovation
en.summary: China aims to expand its intelligent computing capacity more than fourfold by 2030 to advance artificial intelligence development. Achieving this target while facing US restrictions on importing advanced Western AI chips will require significant innovation and resource coordination.

stories.title: Hong Kong ranks 7th globally in drawing next wealthy class – trailing Singapore: study

en.title: Hong Kong ranks 7th globally in drawing next wealthy class – trailing Singapore: study
en.summary: Hong Kong ranked seventh globally for attracting and retaining next-generation high-net-worth individuals, behind Singapore's sixth place ranking. Both Asia-Pacific finance hubs are competing to strengthen their positions as regional wealth-management centres during an unprecedented intergenerational wealth transfer.

stories.title: From stock losses to bond bets: 5 figures investors are watching in China

en.title: From stock losses to bond bets: 5 figures investors are watching in China
en.summary: Chinese technology stocks declined, driving the CSI 300 Index to a 13-month low despite Beijing's interest rate cut aimed at supporting the economy. Chinese government bonds gained investor attention as US Treasury yields reached new highs.
